stations.title: Kasimir
stations.say: Why is the laptop slower daily?

stations.title: Waiting shelf
stations.text: Clocks wait days for parts, then go home.

stations.title: The laptop
stations.text: Gets its memory back from every repair.

captions: Kasimir takes in a pocket watch that has to wait a week for a part.
It goes home on Friday, yet the laptop still holds its memory, and gets slower.
You make repairs that stay as long as they must, and end each one exactly once.
Now the pocket watch leaves the shelf and its memory goes back to the laptop.
Every repair taken in is ended once. Next, a pointer that ends its repair by itself.
